info.title: CrewAI AMP API
info.description:
REST API for interacting with your deployed CrewAI crews on CrewAI AMP.

## Getting Started

1. **Find your crew URL**: Get your unique crew URL from the CrewAI AMP dashboard
2. **Copy examples**: Use the code examples from each endpoint page as templates
3. **Replace placeholders**: Update URLs and tokens with your actual values
4. **Test with your tools**: Use cURL, Postman, or your preferred API client

## Authentication

All API requests require a bearer token for authentication. There are two types of tokens:

- **Bearer Token**: Organization-level token for full crew operations
- **User Bearer Token**: User-scoped token for individual access with limited permissions

You can find your bearer tokens in the Status tab of your crew's detail page in the CrewAI AMP dashboard.

## Reference Documentation

This documentation provides comprehensive examples for each endpoint:

- **Request formats** with all required and optional parameters
- **Response examples** for success and error scenarios
- **Code samples** in multiple programming languages
- **Authentication patterns** with proper Bearer token usage

Copy the examples and customize them with your actual crew URL and authentication tokens.

## Workflow

1. **Discover inputs** using `GET /inputs`
2. **Start execution** using `POST /kickoff`
3. **Monitor progress** using `GET /status/{kickoff_id}`

get.description:
**📋 Reference Example Only** - *This shows the request format. To test with your actual crew, copy the cURL example and replace the URL + token with your real values.*

Retrieves the list of all required input parameters that your crew expects for execution.
Use this endpoint to discover what inputs you need to provide when starting a crew execution.

inputs.description: Array of required input parameter names

post.description:
**📋 Reference Example Only** - *This shows the request format. To test with your actual crew, copy the cURL example and replace the URL + token with your real values.*

Initiates a new crew execution with the provided inputs. Returns a kickoff ID that can be used
to track the execution progress and retrieve results.

Crew executions can take anywhere from seconds to minutes depending on their complexity.
Consider using webhooks for real-time notifications or implement polling with the status endpoint.

inputs.description: Key-value pairs of all required inputs for your crew

example.interests: games, tech, ai, relaxing hikes, amazing food

meta.description: Additional metadata to pass to the crew

taskWebhookUrl.description: Callback URL executed after each task completion

stepWebhookUrl.description: Callback URL executed after each agent thought/action

crewWebhookUrl.description: Callback URL executed when the crew execution completes

inputs.interests: games, tech, ai, relaxing hikes, amazing food

kickoff_id.description: Unique identifier for tracking this execution

400.description: Invalid request body or missing required inputs

422.description: Validation error - ensure all required inputs are provided

get.description:
**📋 Reference Example Only** - *This shows the request format. To test with your actual crew, copy the cURL example and replace the URL + token with your real values.*

Retrieves the current status and results of a crew execution using its kickoff ID.

The response structure varies depending on the execution state:
- **running**: Execution in progress with current task info
- **completed**: Execution finished with full results
- **error**: Execution failed with error details

parameters.name: kickoff_id
parameters.description: The kickoff ID returned from the /kickoff endpoint

example.message: No execution found with ID: abcd1234-5678-90ef-ghij-klmnopqrstuv

post.summary: Resume Crew Execution with Human Feedback
post.description:
**📋 Reference Example Only** - *This shows the request format. To test with your actual crew, copy the cURL example and replace the URL + token with your real values.*

Resume a paused crew execution with human feedback for Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows.
When a task with `human_input=True` completes, the crew execution pauses and waits for human feedback.

**IMPORTANT**: You must provide the same webhook URLs (`taskWebhookUrl`, `stepWebhookUrl`, `crewWebhookUrl`)
that were used in the original kickoff call. Webhook configurations are NOT automatically carried over -
they must be explicitly provided in the resume request to continue receiving notifications.

execution_id.description: The unique identifier for the crew execution (from kickoff)

task_id.description: The ID of the task that requires human feedback

human_feedback.description: Your feedback on the task output. This will be incorporated as additional context for subsequent task executions.
human_feedback.example: Great research! Please add more details about recent developments in the field.

is_approve.description: Whether you approve the task output: true = positive feedback (continue), false = negative feedback (retry task)

taskWebhookUrl.description: Callback URL executed after each task completion. MUST be provided to continue receiving task notifications.

stepWebhookUrl.description: Callback URL executed after each agent thought/action. MUST be provided to continue receiving step notifications.

crewWebhookUrl.description: Callback URL executed when the crew execution completes. MUST be provided to receive completion notification.

value.human_feedback: Excellent research! Proceed to the next task.
Please include more quantitative data and cite your sources.

message.description: Human-readable message about the resume operation

retrying.summary: Task will be retried with negative feedback

value.message: Task will be retried with your feedback

400.description: Invalid request body or execution not in pending state

example.message: Execution is not in pending human input state

404.description: Execution ID or Task ID not found

Use your actual Bearer Token or User Bearer Token from the CrewAI AMP dashboard for real API calls.

**Bearer Token**: Organization-level access for full crew operations
**User Bearer Token**: User-scoped access with limited permissions

state.description: Execution state, such as PENDING, STARTED, RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED, FAILURE or NOT FOUND.

status.description: Human-readable status. On a failed execution it carries the error message.

result.description: Final output of the crew or flow, set when the state is SUCCESS.

last_step.description: Last step the crew or flow executed.

UnauthorizedError.description: Authentication failed - check your bearer token
